       s.gsserved AS "Grade Span Served"
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
 AND sat.rtype = 'S'

  AND s.eilname = 'High School'

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM schools AS other
      LEFT JOIN satscores AS other_sat
        ON other_sat.cds = other.cdscode
       AND other_sat.rtype = 'S'
      WHERE other.ncesdist = '0613360'
        AND other.statustype = 'Active'
        AND other.eilname = 'High School'
        AND other.gsserved IS NOT NULL
        AND other.gsserved ~ '(^|[, -])12($|[, -])'
        AND (other_sat.cds IS NULL OR other_sat.numtsttakr = 0)
        AND CASE
              WHEN split_part(other.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'P' THEN 0
              WHEN split_part(other.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'K' THEN 1
              WHEN split_part(other.gsserved, '-', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN split_part(other.gsserved, '-', 1)::integer + 1
              ELSE 999
            END
            <
            CASE
              WHEN split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'P' THEN 0
              WHEN split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'K' THEN 1
              WHEN split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1)::integer + 1

            END
  )

WITH district_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.district,
        s.county,
        s.admfname1,
        s.admfname2,
        s.admfname3
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND s.doc IN ('00', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06')
),
name_totals AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS school_count
    FROM district_schools
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES (admfname1), (admfname2), (admfname3)
    ) AS admins(first_name)
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND first_name <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM name_totals
    ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
district_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district
    FROM district_schools
)
SELECT

    n.first_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FILTER (
        WHERE n.first_name IN (s.admfname1, s.admfname2, s.admfname3)
    ) AS school_count
FROM district_names AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS n
LEFT JOIN district_schools AS s
    ON s.district = d.district
GROUP BY d.district, n.first_name
ORDER BY d.district, n.first_name

SELECT
    funding_category,
    COUNT(*) AS active_charter_school_count,
    SUM(enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(meal_eligibility_percentage)::numeric, 2) AS average_meal_eligibility_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(combined_sat_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_combined_sat_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS meal_eligibility_percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN sat.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
             AND sat.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
             AND sat.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
            THEN sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite
        END AS combined_sat_score
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f
      ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
      ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
     AND sat.rtype = 'S'
    WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
      AND s.charter = 1
      AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
      AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
) AS active_charters
GROUP BY funding_category
ORDER BY funding_category

SELECT
    county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND("Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100, 2))::numeric, 2) AS average_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND("FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100, 2))::numeric, 2) AS average_frpm_percentage,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE charter_indicator = 1) AS charter_school_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE charter_indicator = 0) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(sat_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_sat_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        f."County Name" AS county_name,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)",
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
        f."Enrollment (K-12)",
        f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_indicator,
        s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite AS sat_score
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools sch ON sch.cdscode = f.cdscode
    LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
    WHERE f."County Name" = (
        SELECT f0."County Name"
        FROM frpm f0
        WHERE f0.cdscode = '1612590125716'
    )
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
) qualifying_schools
GROUP BY county_name

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f."cdscode",
        f."School Name",
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN s.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN s.charter = 0 THEN 'No'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS charter_status,
        s.gsserved AS grades_served,
        CASE
            WHEN sat.cds IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average'
        END AS sat_performance
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
      AND s.gsserved LIKE '%12%'
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
)
SELECT
    "School Name",
    ROUND(free_meal_rate::numeric, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    charter_status,
    grades_served,
    sat_performance
FROM eligible_schools
WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible_schools)

SELECT
    s.school AS school_name,
    s.phone,
    s.website,
    sat.avgscrread AS average_sat_reading,
    sat.avgscrmath AS average_sat_math,
    sat.avgscrwrite AS average_sat_writing,
    (s.charter = 1) AS is_charter,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::numeric, 2) AS percent_eligible_frpm,
    best.highest_average_sat_math,
    best.highest_average_sat_math - sat.avgscrmath AS points_below_highest
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(ss.avgscrmath) AS highest_average_sat_math
    FROM satscores AS ss
    JOIN schools AS active_school
        ON active_school.cdscode = ss.cds
    WHERE active_school.statustype = 'Active'
      AND ss.numtsttakr >= 10
) AS best
WHERE s.cdscode = '7618040113118'

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        cdscode,
        county,
        school
    FROM schools
    WHERE virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        county,
        COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY county
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT county, virtual_school_count
    FROM county_counts
    ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC
    FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS WITH TIES
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        v.county,
        v.school,
        s.avgscrread,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.county
            ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS reading_rank
    FROM virtual_schools AS v
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
        ON s.cds = v.cdscode
       AND s.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT
    t.county,
    t.virtual_school_count,
    COALESCE(
        STRING_AGG(r.school, ', ' ORDER BY r.school)
            FILTER (WHERE r.reading_rank = 1 AND r.avgscrread IS NOT NULL),
        'None'
    ) AS school
FROM top_counties AS t
LEFT JOIN ranked_schools AS r
    ON r.county = t.county
GROUP BY t.county, t.virtual_school_count
ORDER BY t.virtual_school_count DESC, t.county

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.cdscode,
        s.school,
        s.county,
        s.city,
        s.mailstreet,
        s.mailcity,
        s.mailstate,
        s.mailzip,
        s.website,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share,
        (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) AS avg_total_sat,
        100.0 * sat.numge1500 / NULLIF(sat.numtsttakr, 0) AS pct_1500_or_more,
        s.opendate,
        CASE WHEN s.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status,
        sat.numtsttakr
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = f.cdscode
    WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
      AND s.edopscode = 'TRAD'
      AND COALESCE(s.charter, 0) = 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(frpm_count) OVER () AS largest_count,
        MIN(frpm_share) OVER () AS smallest_share
    FROM eligible
),
answers AS (
    SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE frpm_count = largest_count
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE frpm_share = smallest_share
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE cdscode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
    part,
    school,
    county,
    city,
    mailstreet,
    mailcity,
    mailstate,
    mailzip,
    website,
    enrollment,
    frpm_count,
    frpm_share,
    avg_total_sat,
    pct_1500_or_more,
    opendate,
    status
FROM answers
ORDER BY

WITH customer_totals AS (

      AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.date >= '2013-01'
      AND y.date < '2014-01'
    GROUP BY c.segment, c.customerid
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment)
        segment,
        customerid,
        total_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    ORDER BY segment, total_consumption, customerid
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme_total,
        MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam_total,
        MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam_total
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    ROUND((sme_total - lam_total)::numeric, 2) AS "SME minus LAM",

FROM totals

       ROUND(AVG(a.chancecreationpassing)::numeric, 1) AS average_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM team t
JOIN risky_teams r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN duplicate_short_names d ON d.team_short_name = t.team_short_name
JOIN attributes_on_date a ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, t.team_short_name

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM player AS p
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate
    FROM player_attributes AS pa
    WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
      AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS latest ON latest.defensive_work_rate = 'medium'
WHERE p.birthday::date >= DATE '1990-01-01'
  AND p.birthday::date < DATE '1996-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1)
FROM player AS p
JOIN player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played
FROM player AS p
JOIN match AS m
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%'
  AND p.weight > 170
  AND m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name

SELECT ta.buildupplaydribblingclass
FROM team AS t
JOIN team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'POR'
  AND ta.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM match AS m
      JOIN country AS c ON c.id = m.country_id
      WHERE c.name = 'England'
        AND (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
  )

SELECT
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS home_wins
FROM "match" AS m
JOIN team AS t
    ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
  AND (
      SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
      FROM team_attributes AS ta
      WHERE ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        AND ta.date::date <= m.date::date
      ORDER BY ta.date::date DESC
      LIMIT 1
  ) = 'Fast'
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
ORDER BY home_wins DESC, t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id

SELECT
    season,
    COUNT(DISTINCT away_player_id) AS different_players
FROM "match"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
        (away_player_1), (away_player_2), (away_player_3),
        (away_player_4), (away_player_5), (away_player_6),
        (away_player_7), (away_player_8), (away_player_9),
        (away_player_10), (away_player_11)
) AS away_lineup(away_player_id)
WHERE home_team_goal - away_team_goal >= 5
  AND away_player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season

SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS qualifying_players
FROM country AS c
JOIN match AS m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN team AS t ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
JOIN match AS appearance_match ON appearance_match.id = m.id
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    appearance_match.home_player_1, appearance_match.home_player_2,
    appearance_match.home_player_3, appearance_match.home_player_4,
    appearance_match.home_player_5, appearance_match.home_player_6,
    appearance_match.home_player_7, appearance_match.home_player_8,
    appearance_match.home_player_9, appearance_match.home_player_10,
    appearance_match.home_player_11, appearance_match.away_player_1,
    appearance_match.away_player_2, appearance_match.away_player_3,
    appearance_match.away_player_4, appearance_match.away_player_5,
    appearance_match.away_player_6, appearance_match.away_player_7,
    appearance_match.away_player_8, appearance_match.away_player_9,
    appearance_match.away_player_10, appearance_match.away_player_11
)
WHERE p.weight >= 210
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(player_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.player_api_id) AS player_count
        FROM country AS c2
        JOIN match AS m2 ON m2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN player AS p2 ON p2.player_api_id IN (
            m2.home_player_1, m2.home_player_2, m2.home_player_3,
            m2.home_player_4, m2.home_player_5, m2.home_player_6,
            m2.home_player_7, m2.home_player_8, m2.home_player_9,
            m2.home_player_10, m2.home_player_11, m2.away_player_1,
            m2.away_player_2, m2.away_player_3, m2.away_player_4,
            m2.away_player_5, m2.away_player_6, m2.away_player_7,
            m2.away_player_8, m2.away_player_9, m2.away_player_10,
            m2.away_player_11
        )
        WHERE p2.weight >= 210
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) AS counts
)
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT m.season,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM "match" AS m
JOIN league AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
JOIN country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
        (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3),
        (m.home_player_4), (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6),
        (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8), (m.home_player_9),
        (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
        (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3),
        (m.away_player_4), (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6),
        (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8), (m.away_player_9),
        (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
) AS lineup(player_api_id)
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_api_id = lineup.player_api_id
WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
  AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
GROUP BY m.season
ORDER BY m.season

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM player AS p
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT pa.volleys
    FROM player_attributes AS pa
    WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS latest ON TRUE
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND latest.volleys > 70

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(player_totals.total_home_goals, 0)), 2)
FROM player
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT m.home_player_3 AS player_api_id,
           SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
    FROM match AS m
    WHERE m.home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.home_player_3
) AS player_totals
    ON player.player_api_id = player_totals.player_api_id

WITH country_player_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count
    FROM "match" m
    JOIN country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES
            (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3),
            (m.home_player_4), (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6),
            (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8), (m.home_player_9),
            (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
            (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3),
            (m.away_player_4), (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6),
            (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8), (m.away_player_9),
            (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
    ) AS participants(player_api_id)
    JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = participants.player_api_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM country_player_counts
WHERE player_count = (SELECT MIN(player_count) FROM country_player_counts)
ORDER BY name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)
FROM player AS p
JOIN player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date::date <= DATE '2015-01-01'
  AND pa.date::date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date::date)
    FROM player_attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
      AND pa2.date::date <= DATE '2015-01-01'
  )
  AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND pa.attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')

    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE latest.attacking_work_rate = 'low')
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    1
)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id)

    FROM player_attributes
    ORDER BY player_api_id, date DESC, id DESC

WHERE latest.preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id)
FROM player_attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND date::date BETWEEN DATE '2007-02-22' AND DATE '2007-08-30'

SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
FROM "match" AS m
JOIN team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
  FROM team_attributes AS ta
  WHERE ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    AND ta.date::date <= m.date::date
  ORDER BY ta.date::date DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS ta ON TRUE
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  AND m.season = '2012/2013'
  AND m.date::date = (
    SELECT MAX(m2.date::date)
    FROM "match" AS m2
    WHERE m2.season = '2012/2013'
      AND t.team_api_id IN (m2.home_team_api_id, m2.away_team_api_id)
  )
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (donovan.overall_rating - cohort.avg_rating) / cohort.avg_rating,
    2
)
FROM (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM player_attributes AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
      AND pa.date::date = DATE '2013-07-12'
      AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
) AS donovan
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(latest.overall_rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.player_api_id)
            pa.player_api_id,
            pa.overall_rating,
            pa.defensive_work_rate
        FROM player_attributes AS pa
        WHERE pa.date::date <= DATE '2013-07-12'
        ORDER BY pa.player_api_id, pa.date::date DESC
    ) AS latest
    WHERE latest.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
) AS cohort

SELECT
  oldest.account_id,
  salary_range.highest_average_salary - salary_range.lowest_average_salary AS salary_difference
FROM (
  SELECT d.district_id
  FROM district d
  ORDER BY d.a14 ASC
  LIMIT 1
) lowest_district
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT disp.account_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND c.district_id = lowest_district.district_id
  ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
  LIMIT 1
) oldest
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT MAX(a14) AS highest_average_salary, MIN(a14) AS lowest_average_salary
  FROM district
) salary_range

SELECT d.a2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.district_id = (
      SELECT d2.district_id
      FROM district d2
      WHERE d2.a3 = 'south Bohemia'
      ORDER BY d2.a4::bigint DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )

SELECT
  (final_balance - initial_balance) * 100.0 / initial_balance AS percentage_increase
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(balance) FILTER (WHERE date = DATE '1993-03-22') AS initial_balance,
    MAX(balance) FILTER (WHERE date = DATE '1998-12-27') AS final_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  )
    AND date IN (DATE '1993-03-22', DATE '1998-12-27')
) AS balances

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < DATE '2001-01-01'
  AND d.a3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    ROUND(((d.a13 - d.a12) / NULLIF(d.a12, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
  AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL

SELECT dp.type, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.account_id)
FROM disp AS dp
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dp.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND d.a11 > 8000
  AND d.a11 <= 9000
GROUP BY dp.type

SELECT
  100.0 * (
    SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997) -
    SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996)
  ) / SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996) AS percentage_growth
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) IN (1996, 1997)

SELECT
  a.frequency,
  o.k_symbol
FROM account AS a
JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date))::date AS month_start
  FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  CROSS JOIN first_month fm
  WHERE a.date >= fm.month_start
    AND a.date < fm.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
),
district_populations AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a4 AS inhabitants
  FROM district d
  JOIN opened_districts od ON od.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district_id, inhabitants
FROM district_populations
WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM district_populations)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01'
  AND c.birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol = ''

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2
    FROM district
    ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
district_burden AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.a2,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')), 0)::numeric
            / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id), 0) AS average_active_loan
    FROM top_districts d
    LEFT JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        a2,
        average_active_loan,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY average_active_loan DESC) AS burden_rank
    FROM district_burden
)
SELECT a2, ROUND(average_active_loan)::bigint AS average_active_loan
FROM ranked
WHERE burden_rank = 1

WITH active_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.a3 AS region,
        l.amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
      AND (l.date + (l.duration::integer * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day')::date >= DATE '1995-12-31'
      AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM active_loans
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region, total
FROM region_totals
WHERE total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM region_totals)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.bank = 'AB'
  )

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account AS a
      JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
      JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01'
        AND c.birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01'
  )

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT d.district_id, AVG(d.a11) AS district_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account a
      ON a.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp account_disp
          JOIN card ca
            ON ca.disp_id = account_disp.disp_id
          WHERE account_disp.account_id = a.account_id
      )
    GROUP BY d.district_id
) district_averages

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COUNT(l.loan_id)) OVER (), 2)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO'
      AND t.k_symbol <> ''
  ) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) IN (1974, 1975, 1976)
  AND t.amount > 4000
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol <> ''

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET' THEN (t.bank, t.account)
        WHEN t.operation = 'PREVOD Z UCTU' THEN (t.bank, t.account)
    END) AS outside_bank_counterparties,
    owner_district.a2 AS owner_home_district,
    owner_district.a4 AS population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY owner_district.a4::bigint DESC
    ) AS population_rank
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS branch_district
    ON branch_district.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN disp AS owner_disp
    ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
   AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS owner_client
    ON owner_client.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
JOIN district AS owner_district
    ON owner_district.district_id = owner_client.district_id
JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE branch_district.a2 = 'Prachatice'
GROUP BY
    a.account_id,
    a.date,
    owner_district.a2,
    owner_district.a4
ORDER BY
    owner_district.a4::bigint DESC,
    a.account_id

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.gender,
        branch.district_id,
        d.a8 AS inhabitants,
        d.a11 AS salary,
        d.a12 AS urban_ratio
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch
      ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = branch.district_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
      AND d.a8 > 100000
      AND (
          SELECT AVG(t.balance)
          FROM trans AS t
          WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      ) > 1000
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
        ROUND(AVG(salary)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::numeric, 2) AS average_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    s.gender,
    s.district_count,
    q.district_id,
    q.inhabitants,
    s.average_salary,
    s.average_urban_ratio
FROM district_stats AS s
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
  ON q.gender = s.gender
 AND q.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END, q.district_id

WITH pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account AS counter_account,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payments,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
        ON owner_disp.account_id = t.account_id
       AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < DATE '1999-01-01'
      AND d.a4::BIGINT >= 250000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS c
          WHERE c.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
            AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        bank,
        counter_account,
        outgoing_payments,
        total_amount,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
    bank,
    counter_account,
    outgoing_payments,
    total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY bank, counter_account

SELECT ROUND(

    / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0),

)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek'

  AND t.k_symbol <> ''

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.a3 AS region,
        cl.district_id
    FROM client cl
    JOIN disp dp
      ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card c
      ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    JOIN loan l
      ON l.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        qd.region,
        ROUND(AVG(d.a11), 2) AS avg_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(d.a12), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM qualifying_districts qd
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = qd.district_id
    GROUP BY qd.region
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        qd.region,
        d.a2 AS district_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY qd.region
            ORDER BY d.a8 DESC, d.a2 ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM qualifying_districts qd
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = qd.district_id
)
SELECT
    ra.region,
    ra.avg_salary,
    ra.avg_unemployment_1996,
    rd.district_name
FROM region_averages ra
JOIN ranked_districts rd
  ON rd.region = ra.region
 AND rd.rn = 1
ORDER BY ra.region

SELECT
    x.district_name,
    x.inhabitants,
    x.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(x.crimes_1996) OVER (PARTITION BY x.region), 2) AS central_bohemia_average,
    ROUND(AVG(x.crimes_1996) OVER (), 2) AS country_average,
    ROUND(
        AVG(x.crimes_1996) OVER (PARTITION BY x.region)
        - AVG(x.crimes_1996) OVER (),
        2
    ) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.a2 AS district_name,
        d.a3 AS region,
        d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
        d.a16::bigint AS crimes_1996,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.a3
            ORDER BY d.a4::bigint DESC, d.a2 COLLATE "und-x-icu"
        ) AS region_rank
    FROM district AS d
) AS x
WHERE x.region = 'central Bohemia'
  AND x.region_rank <= 3
ORDER BY x.inhabitants DESC, x.district_name COLLATE "und-x-icu"

SELECT c.type AS card_type, d.a2 AS home_district, d.a4 AS inhabitants
FROM card AS c

JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id

    JOIN district AS d2 ON d2.district_id = cl2.district_id

GROUP BY c.type, d.a2, d.a4
ORDER BY c.type, d.a2

WITH region_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    WHERE a3 = (

    )
),
account_balances AS (

        rd.district_name,
        t.balance
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN region_districts AS rd

    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT tr.balance
        FROM trans AS tr
        WHERE tr.account_id = a.account_id
          AND tr.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
        ORDER BY tr.date DESC, tr.trans_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS t ON TRUE
    WHERE a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
        ROUND(AVG(balance::numeric), 2) AS average_balance
    FROM account_balances
    GROUP BY district_name
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance::numeric), 2) AS average_balance
    FROM account_balances
),
top_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    ORDER BY average_balance DESC, district_name
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    'district' AS row_type,
    district_name,
    accounts_opened,
    average_balance,
    NULL::numeric AS region_average_balance,
    NULL::text AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'region',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    region_stats.average_balance,
    top_district.district_name
FROM region_stats
CROSS JOIN top_district
ORDER BY row_type, district_name

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.a4 AS inhabitants,
        d.a11 AS average_salary
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN top_districts AS td ON td.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT district_id
     FROM district_stats
     ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS district_id,
    (SELECT inhabitants
     FROM district_stats
     ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary
FROM district_stats

SELECT
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    d.a4 AS population,
    w.total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::numeric, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::numeric DESC
    ) AS rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(COALESCE(o.total_standing_order_debits, 0)::numeric / a.account_count, 2)
        AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district AS d
JOIN (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
) AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
) AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debits
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
) AS o ON o.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date,
    a.frequency,
    ad.a2,
    ad.a3,
    CASE WHEN ad.district_id = c.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END,
    ad.a11,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0),
    COUNT(t.trans_id),
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0),
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0),
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0),
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM client rc
        JOIN district rd ON rd.district_id = rc.district_id
        WHERE rd.a3 = ad.a3
    ),
    rp.a2,
    rp.a8,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.a3 ORDER BY ad.a8 DESC)
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2, a8
    FROM district
    ORDER BY a3, a8 DESC
) rp ON rp.a3 = ad.a3
WHERE c.client_id = 3541
GROUP BY
    a.account_id, a.date, a.frequency,
    ad.district_id, ad.a2, ad.a3, ad.a11, ad.a8,
    c.district_id, l.status, l.amount,
    rp.a2, rp.a8
ORDER BY COUNT(t.trans_id) DESC, a.account_id ASC

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)::integer::text AS account_opening_year,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
  COALESCE(SUM(l.total_lent), 0) AS total_amount_lent,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.total_lent, 0)::numeric), 2) AS average_amount_lent_per_account
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d
  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_lent
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
) AS l
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)

SELECT
    d.a2,

    l.date,
    t.balance
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT tr.balance
    FROM trans AS tr
    WHERE tr.account_id = l.account_id
      AND tr.date = l.date
    ORDER BY tr.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS t ON TRUE
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    ca.type,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.issued)::integer - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date)::integer AS age_at_card_issue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT l.amount), 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower'
        WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        ELSE 'Mature borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.gender
        ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date)
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM card ca
JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ca.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND ca.issued < DATE '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    ca.type,
    ca.issued,
    d.a2,
    d.a11
ORDER BY c.client_id

SELECT d.a2 AS branch_name, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id

GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)

WITH eligible_loans AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        branch.a2 AS district,
        branch.a3 AS region,
        c.birth_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS dp
      ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch
      ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 3
),
account_activity AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.a3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
),
regional_salary AS (
    SELECT
        a3 AS region,
        ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY a3
)
SELECT
    t.client_id,
    t.amount AS loan_amount,
    t.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND((t.payments * t.duration)::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND((t.payments * t.duration - t.amount)::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
    t.status AS loan_status,
    t.district,
    t.region,
    COALESCE(aa.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(aa.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(aa.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(aa.total_deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.loans_in_region,
    rs.average_salary,
    DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', t.birth_date))::integer AS completed_age
FROM top_loans AS t
LEFT JOIN account_activity AS aa
  ON aa.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN regional_loans AS rl
  ON rl.region = t.region
JOIN regional_salary AS rs
  ON rs.region = t.region
WHERE t.amount >= (
    SELECT amount
    FROM eligible_loans
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    OFFSET 2
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration > 24
      AND date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region
    FROM qualifying_accounts qa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = qa.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT
        qd.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qd.district_id) AS district_count,
        SUM(d.a4::bigint) AS combined_population,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qa.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_districts qd
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = qd.district_id
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = qd.district_id
    JOIN qualifying_accounts qa ON qa.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY qd.region
)
SELECT region, district_count, combined_population, account_count
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    SUM(q.account_count) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(q.average_salary)::numeric, 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.a11 AS average_salary,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < DATE '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a11
) AS q

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_amount_received,
        SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_amount_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS number_of_external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(cc.number_of_external_counterparties, 0) AS number_of_external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(cc.number_of_external_counterparties, 0) DESC
    ) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts ga
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON lc.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts cc ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY rank, a.account_id

WITH target_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        c.gender,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', c.birth_date))::integer AS age
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp AS dp
    JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loan_standing AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        CASE
            WHEN BOOL_OR(l.status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN BOOL_OR(l.status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS standing
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')), 0) AS money_out,
        MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date < DATE '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT
        ta.account_id,
        ta.opened_date,
        ta.gender,
        ta.age,
        COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
        COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(ls.standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ac.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(ac.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(ac.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
        COALESCE(ac.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM target_accounts AS ta
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_standing AS ls ON ls.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity AS ac ON ac.account_id = ta.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opened_date,
    gender,
    age,
    card_count,
    loan_count,
    loan_standing,
    transaction_count,
    money_in,
    money_out,
    peak_balance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id

SELECT
    district.a2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS classic_card_holding_account_owners,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (trans.bank, trans.account)) AS external_accounts_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(trans.amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_payments
FROM district

    ON account.district_id = district.district_id
LEFT JOIN disp
    ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
   AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client
    ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
LEFT JOIN card
    ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
   AND card.type = 'classic'
LEFT JOIN trans
    ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
   AND trans.type = 'VYDAJ'
   AND trans.bank IS NOT NULL
   AND trans.account IS NOT NULL
WHERE card.card_id IS NOT NULL

WITH semester_events AS (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event AS e
    WHERE to_date(e.event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN DATE '2019-09-01' AND DATE '2019-11-30'
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        se.event_id,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM semester_events AS se
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = se.event_id
    GROUP BY se.event_id
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 1) AS rounded_average
    FROM counts
),
target_count AS (
    SELECT c.attendee_count
    FROM counts AS c
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = c.event_id
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Women's Soccer'
)
SELECT
    tc.attendee_count AS attendee_count,
    ac.rounded_average AS average_attendance,
    CASE
        WHEN tc.attendee_count > ac.rounded_average THEN 'more'
        WHEN tc.attendee_count < ac.rounded_average THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM target_count AS tc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac

        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value)::numeric, 1)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm)::numeric, 1)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 2)

WITH strongest_rnp AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::numeric END) AS max_rnp

top_rnp_labs AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM laboratory AS l
  CROSS JOIN strongest_rnp AS s
  WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND l.rnp::numeric = s.max_rnp
),
highest_bilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS max_bilirubin
  FROM top_rnp_labs
)

WITH carcinogenic_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_element_counts AS (
    SELECT ca.element, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.atom_id) AS bonded_count
    FROM carcinogenic_atoms AS ca
    JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = ca.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = ca.atom_id
    GROUP BY ca.element
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT element, bonded_count,
           MAX(bonded_count) OVER () AS max_count
    FROM bonded_element_counts
)
SELECT r.element,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.element = r.element)
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic_atoms), 2) AS percentage
FROM ranked AS r
CROSS JOIN carcinogenic_atoms AS ca
WHERE r.bonded_count = r.max_count
GROUP BY r.element, r.bonded_count
ORDER BY r.element

        SELECT 1
        FROM atom AS other_a
        WHERE other_a.element = a.element
          AND other_a.molecule_id <> a.molecule_id
      )
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END)
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN "atom" a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.label = '+') / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.label = '-') / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bond AS b
  WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    AND b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (
      SELECT a2.element
      FROM atom AS a2
      GROUP BY a2.element
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2.molecule_id) = 1
  )
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id

WITH molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'c') AS carbon_atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'cl') AS chlorine_atom_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a
        ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond AS b
        ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
),
carbon_touching AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FILTER (
            WHERE a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c'
        ) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FILTER (
            WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
        ) AS multiple_bond_count
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a1
        ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2
        ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        mc.molecule_id,
        mc.label,
        mc.atom_count,
        mc.bond_count,
        mc.carbon_atom_count,
        mc.chlorine_atom_count,
        COALESCE(ct.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
        COALESCE(ct.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count
    FROM molecule_counts AS mc
    LEFT JOIN carbon_touching AS ct
        ON ct.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id
    WHERE mc.carbon_atom_count > 0
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    molecule_id,
    label,
    atom_count,
    bond_count,
    carbon_atom_count,
    chlorine_atom_count,
    carbon_touching_bond_count,
    multiple_bond_count
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM atom AS y
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = y.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN atom AS other ON other.atom_id =
    CASE WHEN c.atom_id = a.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END
WHERE y.element = 'y'
  AND a.element = 'h'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS atom_bond_count
    FROM atom AS a
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
) AS atom_degrees

SELECT a2.element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
GROUP BY a2.element

SELECT
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a1.element || '|' || a2.element) AS element_pair_count,
    m.label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1
    ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
    ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, b.bond_type ASC

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
      AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) DESC, a.element ASC

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element
